title: Nephews who play music
summary: Lists nephews on bass, drums, banjo and trombone, one playing rock and roll.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I think he played a job or two here on the bass. And if he went to California, he took up a band shift, a ghetto, a ghetto and a bass. And I was told that he was playing older than good. How long did you stay on Harbridge Street? I don't remember.
